transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Well, they say I’m here because I used up our savings on wood, lights, and display stuff for the house. I just kept pushing the work, staying out there building way after dark. My family is pretty upset about the money, but... I felt like if I stopped, the whole house and the whole block would lose its chance. I just had to keep going.
Has anything like this ever happened to you before?

No, not that I can remember. I mean, I've always liked to keep busy with my hands, but... nothing like this. I've never spent our savings before or felt that kind of pressure to just keep building day and night. This is the first time.
What did you believe would happen to the block if you stopped building?

Well, I know my family thinks I’m a bit mixed up, but... I’m sure this neighborhood was picked for my last big civic art piece. If I stopped, the whole thing would be ruined. And I know I'm right about it because... well, you see little things. Like delivery trucks slowing down when they drive past, or the neighbors looking over the fence. That proves they know it too. They were all just waiting for me to finish it.
Did you start noticing these special signs and meanings before your energy picked up, or did that all begin around the same time?

No, it all started around the same time. Before I got so... charged up with all the building and the plans, I wasn't seeing any special meaning in the delivery trucks or the way the neighbors were looking at me. All of those signs, you know, they only started happening once I felt that drive to turn the house into my big civic project. That's when I started noticing it all.
